definitions.explanation: A state of having lost honor or reputation. Can function as a noun (a disgrace) or as a na-adjective (dishonorable, disgraceful).

examples.japanese: {不名誉|ふめいよ}な⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up setting a disgraceful record.

examples.japanese: {不名誉|ふめいよ}な⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{喫|きっ}した→喫する：29124_kissuru⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不名誉|ふめいよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらす→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧ようなことはしたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to do anything that would bring disgrace upon my family.

notes:
{不名誉|ふめいよ} describes a loss of honor or reputation. Functions as both a na-adjective ({不名誉|ふめいよ}な) and a noun.

FORMS:
{不|ふ} (negative prefix) + ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧ (honor, prestige).

AS NA-ADJECTIVE:
- {不名誉|ふめいよ}な⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: disgraceful record
- {不名誉|ふめいよ}な⟦{敗北|はいぼく}→敗北：12872_haiboku⟧: humiliating defeat
- {不名誉|ふめいよ}な{称号|しょうごう}: dishonorable title
- {不名誉|ふめいよ}な⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: shameful result

AS NOUN:
- {不名誉|ふめいよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{被|こうむ}る→被る：18070_koumuru⟧: to suffer disgrace
- {不名誉|ふめいよ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらす→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧: to bring dishonor

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧ (honor, prestige). Compare ⟦{名誉|めいよ}→名誉：10568_meiyo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧ (prestigious award) vs. {不名誉|ふめいよ}な⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧ (disgraceful record).

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal. In casual speech, ⟦{恥|は}ずかしい→恥ずかしい：00843_hazukashii⟧ (embarrassing) or ⟦{情|なさ}けない→情けない：03129_nasakenai⟧ (pathetic) express similar sentiments.
